records.canonicalEnglish:
Sion: Tickets? With a line that long, we’ll never get any!
Joe: Bwahahaha! Well, there’s nothing for it.
Joe: I didn’t want to fly her while she was still unfinished, but I suppose we’ll use the spacecraft I built!
Sion: What? Your spacecraft, Joe?!
Shoko: Don’t tell me it’s made of scrap...
Joe: Don’t you worry. I built her myself! You won’t find a better ship in the Mars Federation.
Shoko: Are you sure about that...?
Joe: Mind you, young lady, you’re right about the scrap. That’s what I built her from.
Joe: Still, we can’t afford to be choosy now.
Karu: Joe, where is your spaceship?
Joe: Well, Karu? Eager to get aboard, are you? Unfortunately, she isn’t here.
Shoko: What?! Then where...?
Joe: I’ve hidden her in an abandoned mine north of here.
Sion: (Hmm. Of course it couldn’t be that easy...)
Joe: Hm? Did you say something, Sion?
Sion: No, nothing...
Sion: Well, shall we head off to explore the mine?
